# motherduck_table (Resource)

Manages a MotherDuck table definition. Column changes replace the table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "motherduck_database" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics"
}

resource "motherduck_schema" "mart" {
  database = motherduck_database.analytics.name
  name     = "mart"
}

resource "motherduck_table" "events" {
  database = motherduck_database.analytics.name
  schema   = motherduck_schema.mart.name
  name     = "events"

  columns = {
    event_id    = "VARCHAR"
    occurred_at = "TIMESTAMP"
    payload     = "JSON"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `columns` (Map of String) Map of column name to DuckDB SQL type. Type aliases are compared semantically during refresh to avoid replacement churn.
- `database` (String) Database that contains the table.
- `name` (String) Table name.
- `schema` (String) Schema that contains the table.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Table resource ID in `<database>.<schema>.<table>` form.
